HasZeroSetContact.text: HISTORICAL: HasZeroSetContact, HasHalfPlaneContact and ContactPilot.refutation (negating the old SourceConjecture) belong to the r5 chain. Review r2 failed general locality: one existential radius could let an upper witness come from a different boundary cluster, even allowing orders 2 and 6 at the same named point. The root ruling agreed and held acceptance. The five-vertex mathematics survived because its roots actually localize. The r6 repair fixes the lower neighborhood and requires an upper witness in every smaller neighborhood with the same C. Review r3 passed A, B and bounded C, with D qualified pending manuscript integration. Historical declarations remain in the packet for provenance; they are not the operative local definition or endpoint.
